drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile
discardPhase: Discard a card, or discard it and knock
layoffPhase: Lay off cards onto the knocker's melds

tutorial.drawArea: Draw a card from the stock pile or discard pile.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Form melds (3+ same rank, or 3+ same-suit runs) to reduce deadwood.
tutorial.discardButton: Discard one card from your hand.
tutorial.knockButton: When your deadwood is at or below the limit, pick the card to discard and knock.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

frontendHint.chinchonTakeDiscard: The discard connects with your hand — take it
frontendHint.chinchonDrawStock: The discard connects with nothing — draw from the stock
frontendHint.chinchonDiscardHeavy: Your heaviest unconnected card. You are scored on what stays in hand
